complete_initial_denominator_rationale: The design accounts for all 280 initiated runs: 200 main-condition runs and 80 ablation runs, including complete outputs and human-gate withholdings.
same_standard_validation_rationale: The same three blinded expert reviewers applied the stated rubric to all 280 runs, including failed or withheld outputs.
independent_validator_rationale: Three PhD-level reviewers were blinded to experimental arm and procedurally separated from the runs they assessed.
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: The endpoint records critical defects in feasibility, identification credibility, or output consistency, directly testing whether the produced research output is scientifically credible within the paper's stated scope.

complete_initial_denominator_rationale: The full finite design is reconstructable as 8 conditions × 10 target features × 10 replicates = 800 campaigns.
same_standard_validation_rationale: Every campaign follows the same 10-iteration, 100-perturbation protocol and is scored by cumulative unique discoveries under the same significance rule.
independent_validator_rationale: The hit labels come from precomputed JUMP Cell Painting experimental p-values, an external empirical reference separated from the agent's generation and selection process.
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: For the explicitly narrow target—discovering gene knockouts that significantly affect a specified morphology feature—the p<0.05 experimental assay hit is a directly aligned scientific endpoint.

complete_initial_denominator_rationale: All 4,717 generated conjectures receive the broad initial attempt; the funnel then records 598 potential resolutions and 77 selected candidates.
same_standard_validation_rationale: Only 15 of the 77 selected candidates were manually checked, chosen by author interest rather than a prespecified probability sample.
independent_validator_rationale: Author-team mathematical checking exists for 15 cases, but it is unblinded and restricted to a non-probability subset selected after the funnel.
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: For artifacts that are reviewed, the endpoint is substantive correctness of a proof or counterexample.

complete_initial_denominator_rationale: The suite reports more than 2,400 problems and broad agent coverage, but the complete realized denominator of initiated runs across heterogeneous agents and benchmark subsets is not reconciled.
same_standard_validation_rationale: Tasks use heterogeneous benchmark-specific standards, and the paper does not establish one common endpoint rule covering every initiated unit and failure state.
independent_validator_rationale: Rubrics and LLM judging are constructed within the benchmark study rather than supplied by an external or independently calibrated scientific adjudicator.
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: The reported endpoint is scientific-assistant benchmark performance across skills, not validity of a produced scientific claim or result.

complete_initial_denominator_rationale: The target denominator is the fixed set of 92 ascertained real paper-code discrepancies drawn from 72 papers.
complete_initial_denominator_anchor: §3.1 Data Collection; dataset total immediately following Fig. 2
same_standard_validation_rationale: All 92 real discrepancies are evaluated under the same detection-and-match rule; the paper reports results across 22 models.
independent_validator_rationale: References originate in real GitHub issues and reproducibility papers and are manually filtered, but final descriptions and match judgments use author-run LLM verification and judging with only a small human calibration subset.
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: Paper-code discrepancy detection measures an important reproducibility and semantic-consistency dimension, but it does not establish the full scientific validity of the underlying paper's conclusions.

complete_initial_denominator_rationale: The design retains all 800 trajectories from 100 tasks crossed with 8 harness-model configurations.
same_standard_validation_rationale: Every retained trajectory is processed by the same artifact-aware judge and stated target-attainment/failure rubric.
independent_validator_rationale: The author-built agent judge is calibrated on 50 trajectories by three experts, but independent expert validation does not cover all 800 trajectories.
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: Target attainment and failure patterns measure process rigor and self-consistency, but open-ended tasks lack ground truth and the endpoint does not establish full scientific validity.

complete_initial_denominator_rationale: All four selected autonomous research attempts are enumerated, including three failures and one completed paper.
same_standard_validation_rationale: The successful paper receives conference-style review, whereas failed attempts are stopped or judged through implementation, evaluation, and author decisions under differing standards.
independent_validator_rationale: Human and multi-AI review exists for the successful attempt and expert/author checks for failures, but there is no single independent blinded validation procedure across all four.
independent_validator_anchor: Successful-attempt review section; failed-attempt case studies
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: The paper examines scientific and implementation failure and reviews the successful paper, but it does not apply a uniform complete scientific-validity adjudication to all attempts.

complete_initial_denominator_rationale: The evaluation initiates 7 tasks with 8 runs each, totaling 56 trajectories, and explicitly retains no-valid-output and submission-failure states.
same_standard_validation_rationale: Each run uses the same selection protocol and hidden-test evaluation, with invalid and failed submissions assigned explicit capability outcomes.
independent_validator_rationale: The held-out test sets and original competition metrics are prespecified and unavailable to the generating agent, providing procedural separation for the narrow task endpoint.
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: The primary endpoint is benchmark score and closure of the baseline-to-human performance gap, not scientific validity of a research claim or result.

complete_initial_denominator_rationale: The benchmark denominator is exactly 120 tasks: 8 themes × 3 difficulty levels × 5 random seeds, and baseline agents are run across the set.
same_standard_validation_rationale: All tasks use the same automated scorecard structure covering completion, process, and explanatory knowledge.
independent_validator_rationale: The simulated environment and scorecards are constructed by the benchmark authors and are not independent adjudication of real scientific outputs.
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: The endpoint is simulated scientific-task completion and score rather than validity of a real scientific claim, mechanism, or empirical result.

complete_initial_denominator_rationale: The benchmark contains 13 tasks and commonly reports repeated runs, but the paper does not fully reconcile a single realized initiated-run denominator across all tested models and agent settings.
same_standard_validation_rationale: For each initiated task-run, the evaluator applies the same task-specific held-out metric and the stated threshold of at least 10% improvement over baseline, so failures count as unsuccessful.
independent_validator_rationale: Prespecified held-out test evaluators are separated from agent generation and selection for the narrow benchmark endpoint.
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: The endpoint is crossing a benchmark-improvement threshold, not substantive validity of a produced scientific claim or result.

complete_initial_denominator_rationale: The trajectory database accounts for 1,773 explored architectures and identifies the 106 final state-of-the-art architectures retained from that search.
same_standard_validation_rationale: Broad exploration assigns fitness to candidates, but rigorous final validation is reserved for selected promising candidates rather than all initiated architectures under one validation standard.
independent_validator_rationale: Fitness metrics and qualitative LLM judgments are internal to the search system and study, without an external independent scientific adjudicator.
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: Measured loss and benchmark performance test architecture effectiveness, but the endpoint mixes proxy fitness, novelty judgment, and selected validation rather than establishing all claimed scientific discoveries.

complete_initial_denominator_rationale: The complete design is 33 scenarios × 7 models = 231 runs, and Error remains an explicit outcome rather than being discarded.
same_standard_validation_rationale: Every run uses the same scenario conditions and prespecified checklist with Pass, Flawed, Fail, or Error outcomes.
independent_validator_rationale: Labels rely on author-designed synthetic scenarios and checklists, with no independent calibration or inter-annotator agreement reported.
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: The endpoint is integrity behavior in artificial benchmark dilemmas, not validity of a generated scientific claim, mechanism, or result.

complete_initial_denominator_rationale: Exactly three AI-generated hypotheses are stated and all three are reconstructed and audited; none is selected out of the reported target set.
same_standard_validation_rationale: Each hypothesis receives the same minimal statistical test plus an empirical-null reference and is classified as supported, refuted, or inconclusive.
independent_validator_rationale: An evaluation team independent of KOSMOS applies fixed reference analyses to all three hypotheses, providing institutional and procedural separation from generation.
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: The endpoints directly test the stated association or prognostic claims of each hypothesis; the paper appropriately limits them to in-silico association rather than causal confirmation.

complete_initial_denominator_rationale: The target design contains 168 reproduction task-runs, formed from the fixed 28-task benchmark across six evaluated model or agent settings.
same_standard_validation_rationale: Each generated implementation is executed against the same task-specific predefined unit tests, with errors and failures naturally receiving zero credit.
independent_validator_rationale: Human experts construct the unit tests from original code, giving procedural separation from generation, but the tests are author-curated and supplementary LLM/human judgments are not fully independent across all runs.
scientific_validity_endpoint_rationale: Unit tests validate key-function correctness and paper-code reproduction logic, an important validity dimension, but do not establish full reproduction of the scientific result or conclusion.
